proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_stored_spell_reservoir
proposed_widenings.justification: The collection includes the Reserve variant, which must accept arbitrary spells cast into the item by any creature, preserve the original cast metadata, track bounded stored slot-level capacity, and later release one stored spell through the wearer. No existing magic-item mechanics family can model third-party storage plus later release of preserved spell payloads.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This vibrant purple prism stores spells cast into it, holding them until you use them. The stone can store up to 4 levels of spells at a time.

proposed_widenings.name: suppress_food_and_drink_need
proposed_widenings.justification: Sustenance is a deterministic passive benefit, but the current effect surface has no atom for removing food and drink requirements.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You don't need to eat or drink while this clear spindle orbits your head.

proposed_widenings.name: trigger_derived_resource_spend
proposed_widenings.justification: Absorption and Greater Absorption consume burnout capacity equal to the triggering spell's level, not a fixed use and not a player-chosen charge cost. Current item reaction resources cannot spend an amount derived from trigger context.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once the stone has canceled 20 levels of spells, it burns out, turns dull gray, and loses its magic.

notes: Stopped before authoring content because the collection cannot be represented honestly. Several variants fit the existing passive surface, but Reserve forces a missing magic-item family and Sustenance forces a new atom.
